title: Implement JevScore and JevScorecard with specs
description: Write specs first (mocked client), then JevScore, JevScorecard with in-flight-sharing LRU cache, registration, optional typesafe-sdk dependency.

comments.text: Implemented plexus/jev.py (JevSession: one request per item, in-flight-sharing bounded LRU cache), JevScore, JevScorecard (auto-selected when every score is a JevScore, via YAML or API path), lazy registration. 18 mocked specs green; existing Scorecard tests green.
